title: Gateway forgets OSCORE recipient replay windows on restart
description: Security review finding: closed-federation contexts are re-derived from the same PSK/salt/IDs on every startup, while GatewayOscoreSenderStore persists only local sender reservations. Context recipient replay-window state is never durably stored/restored. After restart, a captured pre-reboot OSCORE GCP request has the same keys and an apparently fresh PIV, so it can be accepted again. Link replay does not provide the same end-to-end guarantee: an authenticated relay/node can re-encapsulate the captured IPv6/OSCORE datagram in a fresh link frame. This is especially destructive for POST /handoff, whose timestamp is not freshness-checked and which unregisters node state. Persist and rollback-protect recipient high-water/window atomically with successful unprotect, or rotate to fresh non-repeating context keying material on every restart with coordinated peer enrollment; add a capture/reboot/replay integration test.
